articles.summary: How can we capture more metadata from GEOIP? This has been one of our main concerns with OpenReplay. Has anyone successfully integrated detailed IP data? Capturing this information is essential for us in the insurance industry. Currently, we’re using Full-Storey, but we are looking for alternative options. Can we input data from IPinfo.io? Step-by-step instructions would be greatly appreciated.
articles.title: Magnify IP Address + Ipinfo.io
